about.title: About the Twilight Masquerade set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Twilight Masquerade is a Scarlet & Violet expansion released on 24 May 2024. It has 226 cards: 167 in the main set and 59 secret rares. For a master set there are also 147 reverse holos, and 16 special prints from other products and events.

Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 167 main set cards), the Complete set (all 226 cards), the Master set (373 cards, adding every reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (389 cards, adding the 16 special prints (stamped, Cosmos Holo and other product-exclusive cards)).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
